item.title: Sony MDR-3R USB-C Wired On-Ear Headphones
item.description: Sony MDR-3R USB-C wired on-ear headphones, announced November 5, 2026. From $59.99 (Sony list price). Label: Early. Replaces FiiO DM13 in Tech & Gadgets. Where to buy is the silver Amazon listing.

item.title: HOZO NeoSander
item.description: HOZO NeoSander, a palm-sized detail sander. Kickstarter opened January 20, 2026; the June 11, 2026 retail note says more than $2 million from over 14,000 backers. Amazon listing sold by HOZO. Identified on October 31, 2026 (2026-10-31). Stage at identification: Early–mid.

item.title: Camp Snap screen-free camera
item.description: Camp Snap screen-free digital camera, black, on Amazon. This is the downloadable-filter model, not Camp Snap 2. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early–mid.
